content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am an enthusiast and user of [product_name] and I am searching for its firmware. I have looked extensively for a download link but haven't found anything. Does anyone know where this can be accessed? Best regards, [user_name]
Hi, Firmware updates for [product_name] are not available, and I have never encountered any firmware update files for it. Regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], I contacted [company_name] and received the same response. My intention was not just to update the firmware, but to modify it so the text display could act as an HMI, supporting more language characters and graphics. I was hoping this might be possible on [article_no], Regards, [user_name]
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'Have to copy it to the root folder of the MSD, how does it work?'. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: Participants report that firmware update files for [product_name] cannot be found and are not officially provided. Attempts to access or modify the firmware to add advanced features like multilingual or graphical text displays are unsupported by current offerings. This underscores a limitation in customization and localization options for advanced users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users would like the ability to download, update, or modify the firmware of [product_name] to expand its text display and localization capabilities, especially for advanced HMI scenarios.
